declared.title: Ironic effects of thought suppression: A meta-analysis
declared.foundIn: agent contre-preuve, recherche Crossref / Europe PMC du 2026-11-22 (reports/feeling-bad-about-feeling-bad/counter-evidence.md) ; titre relevé sur Crossref par l'agent : contrôle d'identité plus faible

findings.text: A thought one tries to push away comes back more afterwards; during the effort it grows only under mental load

support.sentence: Consistent with our predictions, rebound effects were observed regardless of cognitive load, whereas immediate enhancement effects were observed only in the presence of cognitive load.
